description: Retrieves Trello board memberships (user roles and permissions) for auditing access or managing collaboration, returning only membership data and not other board content.

filter.description: Filters the types of memberships returned. Valid values are 'all' or a comma-separated list of: 'active', 'admin', 'deactivated', 'me', 'normal'.
filter.title: Filter

idBoard.description: The unique identifier of the Trello board.
idBoard.title: Id Board

member.description: Determines whether to return member objects. Accepts string 'true' or 'false'. If not provided, the API's default behavior for including member details will apply.
member.title: Member

member_fields.description: Specifies the member fields to return. Valid values are 'all' or a comma-separated list of: 'avatarHash', 'bio', 'bioData', 'confirmed', 'fullName', 'idPremOrgsAdmin', 'initials', 'memberType', 'products', 'status', 'url', 'username'.
member_fields.title: Member Fields
